reviews.title: Bueno Bonito y Barato
reviews.comment: Es una muy buena opcion, si estás buscando un buena refrigeracion liquida por poco dinero, yo lo uso con un intel Core i5 9400f y mis temperaturas son: Sin carga : 30°C Full carga: 45-50°C
reviews.author: benjamin araneda

reviews.title: Do not reccomend
reviews.comment: No matter what I did, it didnt cool down my CPU. Not sure what the problem was exactly but my guess is there wasn't any coolant within it. The fan worked and so did the screen. I was able to get everything else to run but the radiator.
reviews.author: Narufinal

reviews.title: Problemas de compatibilidad
reviews.comment: No es compatible con socket Lga1700 de intel, no entra bien
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.title: Bad batch?
reviews.comment: It worked for a few days and then the pump stopped. Maybe I got a bad batch but when it did work it was worth every penny, fit was great. Hardly little to no noise when it worked, but lacks in durability ( like I said I think I got a bad batch as I’ve used this brand before.
reviews.author: Austin Watts
